rules.name: Container Escape via Privileged Pod
rules.description: Kubernetes, container, serverless, and cloud-specific attack detection
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "container" or CommandLine contains "escape" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-CLOUD_NATIVE-067
